rationale: The assistant reached the correct cause ('moisture or pasta water tracking under the control panel' triggering a safety shutdown) and sensibly adjusted when the customer reported it already worked after drying and a 5-minute isolation, with no parts or escalation pushed. Weaknesses: it admitted it did not know Er03 ('not in my standard error catalogue'), whereas this is a standard AEG 'liquid/object on controls' code; the initial 'at least 24 hours' isolation was disproportionate; it never asked whether anything was resting on the control area; and the repeated electrics-tripping safety panel was irrelevant to the situation. No fabrication and the customer was well served overall.
